rules.title: An assistant's voice left in a document
rules.text: `As an AI`, `I hope this helps`, `I'd be happy to`, `Let me know if you need`: the frame of a chat answer, pasted into a document that is not a chat. It addresses one reader who asked, in a file read by whoever arrives next. Delete the frame and keep the answer. Counts the document's own voice only: a guide that quotes the phrasing in order to forbid it, or a transcript shown as sample output, is not a hit.

inspection.pattern: (?mi)^[ \t>*-]{0,4}(?:as an ai\b|as a language model\b|i hope (?:this|that) helps|hope (?:this|that) helps|i(?:'|\u2019)d be happy to|great question|let me know if you (?:need|have|want)|certainly[!,. ]|sure[!,. ])

judgement.question: Does this line open with a chat answer's frame, in a document that is not a chat?

criteria.true: the line opens as a model answering one question (`as an AI`, `I hope this helps`, `I'd be happy to`, `let me know if you need`, `Certainly!`) inside a document
criteria.false: the line quotes the phrasing in order to forbid it, shows it as sample model output or a transcript, is ordinary human support prose, or is a code span or an identifier
